source.authority: Primary appearance reference for this intake; prior battle-reference studies remain historical, unaccepted work.

appearance.identity: Anime fantasy female celestial archer; elegant humanoid silhouette and expressive face.
appearance.hair: Long flowing pink hair, curved layered locks and swept bangs; preserve the gold celestial hair ornaments.
appearance.outfit: Layered white and pink cloth with gold edging, red/pink jewel accents, fitted torso, long split trains and decorative heeled footwear.
appearance.anatomy: Large white feathered wings with overlapping rows; halo above the head. Tail and paw panels require an explicit owner decision.
appearance.weapon: Gold and red fire/light bow with a central jewel; preserve the visible bow silhouette and separate luminous effects from solid geometry.
appearance.materials: Sheet labels silk, metal armor, gemstone, feathers and emission. Palette swatches are visual references, not calibrated PBR values.
appearance.scale: Sheet annotation is approximately 168 cm; confirm whether this excludes halo, wings, hair and heels.

designCompletionTasks.question: Confirm humanoid legs/feet and whether the tail-labelled and paw panels are excluded from Icarus, effects only, or actual anatomy. No tail or paw anatomy is authorized by this intake.

Approve consistent front/side/back neutral orthographic references at usable detail, or supply corrected views. The native sheet turnaround crops are only 299 pixels tall; nearby larger PNGs do not establish new detail or approval.
Supply or approve wing-root placement, folded-wing range, back garment closure, and hair/cloth layering hidden by the back hair. Also confirm the height measurement and intended age impression.

Approve the sheet bow version, grip/handedness and relative scale; distinguish rigid bow/arrow, string, halo/ornaments and luminous VFX. Nearby Phoenix Fire Bow Upgrade files are not a separate approved design.

Record explicit owner approval of the exact immutable design snapshot and input hashes, including resolution of D01-D04, plus permitted provider upload/reference use. Public or production rights remain a separate gate.
